prerequisites: Successful completion of the practical study semester as per APO §30.

learning_outcomes.text: The students are able to concisely name the problem statement (research question) underlying their thesis.
The students can name the methods, technical aids, and procedures they used to create their thesis.
The students can independently work on a problem using scientific methods.
The students can evaluate requirements, alternative solution proposals, and the elaboration of individual solution approaches, and present them in a convincing and comprehensible written form.
The students have learned to complete a comprehensive task within a given timeframe through effective time management.
The students are able to present the essential contents of their thesis to a professional audience.

syllabus_topics: Techniques, methods, and procedures of scientific work
Presentation of requirements and solution approaches
Presenting content to a professional audience
bibliography: SCHLOSSER, Joachim, 2016. Wissenschaftliche Arbeiten schreiben mit LaTeX. 6. Auflage. ISBN 978-3-95845-289-3
